*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_INPUT_FIELD_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       Verarbeiten der internen Angaben zu "Eingabefeld" und "Eingabe
*       Aufbau des externen Attributes dazu                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FIELD_INT    Dynprofeld intern                             *
*      <--P_DYNP_FIELD   Dynprofeld extern                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_INPUT_FIELD_OUT
             USING    VALUE(P_FIELD_INT) TYPE DYNPRO_FIELD
             CHANGING P_DYNP_FIELD       TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD.
DATA: F_RES1 LIKE D021S_RES1.

 F_RES1 = P_FIELD_INT-RES1.

 if p_field_int-flg3 o flg3obl.   " Muss-Feld:
   P_DYNP_FIELD-INPUT_FLD = 'X'.  "  Eingabe: ja
   p_dynp_field-requ_entry = 'O'. "  obligatorisch
 elseif f_res1-recentry <> space. " Soll-Feld:
   P_DYNP_FIELD-INPUT_FLD = 'X'.  "  Eingabe: ja
   p_dynp_field-requ_entry = 'R'. "  recommended
 elseif  P_FIELD_INT-FMB1 Z FMB1GES
     AND P_FIELD_INT-FMB1 Z FMB1NUM.
   P_DYNP_FIELD-INPUT_FLD = 'X'.  "  Eingabe: ja
   p_dynp_field-requ_entry = ' '. "  möglich
 else.
   P_DYNP_FIELD-INPUT_FLD = ' '.  "  Eingabe: nein
   p_dynp_field-requ_entry = 'N'. "  nicht möglich
 endif.

ENDFORM.                    " R_INPUT_FIELD_OUT
